layout.eyebrow: The story of MUVNA and coffee
layout.title: A team that lives coffee
text: There is a special group of people who get together to talk about the art of making the perfect cup, savour the nuances of every bean and spend their lives speaking in terms of water temperature, grind size, roast and extraction curves…
This is the MUVNA team — a team that lives coffee.
It brings together a coffee equipment research lab, a roastery and a coffee shop… Everything here revolves around coffee.
Discover the world of coffee with MUVNA!

layout.title: CLICK new tamper
text: A unique design with a built-in three-stage spring.
Finish every tamp with the signature CLICK.
The flawless mirror-polished stainless steel finish feels reliable and premium.

layout.title: MUVNA smart coffee scales
text: MUVNA smart scales measure precisely in 0.1 g steps with a maximum load of 2 kg.
A range of smart brewing modes for different scenarios: automatic tracking of brew time, water weight, coffee-to-water ratio and more.

layout.title: Precision extraction baskets
text: Compared to standard baskets, our high-precision extraction baskets bring out brighter flavour.
Different hole diameters, counts and patterns give different results during extraction.

layout.title: MUVNA bottomless portafilters
text: An open bottomless design and a wide range of models compatible with the most popular espresso machines let you watch every shot.
Upgradeable: the universal detachable handle comes in resin, solid wood, plastic and silicone.

layout.title: From product to perfection
text: From product to perfection, step by step: specialization, persistence, love and reliability are the principles we stay true to.

text: The MUVNA team is open to dialogue with the coffee community and keen to work with content creators and opinion leaders. If you would like to get to know our products and test new releases, we will be happy to discuss the details — please email us at info@elcanto.ru.

layout.title: For regional dealers
text: In 2026 we are starting to expand the MUVNA distribution network across Russia's regions. We are looking for reliable partners who share the brand's values and want to make modern coffee accessories available to as many coffee lovers as possible.
If you see yourself as part of this, send your proposals to the same address — info@elcanto.ru. We look forward to growing the culture of quality coffee in Russia together.
From product to perfection, step by step: specialization, persistence, love and reliability are the principles we stay true to.
